generic_ballot.method: Same weighting as state averages but half-life 10 days, reference sample 1000, polls older than 120 days dropped. Generic congressional ballot, general stage, 2026 cycle, full-sample questions only. DEM and REP are mean shares (points); margin = REP minus DEM; lo/hi is a 95% band (sampling + 2 pt house SD).

approval.source: New York Times Trump approval average (president-averages.csv)
